entities.summary: Audrey Sauret is a French basketball player currently playing for Union Lyon BF. She has played the EuroLeague with Valenciennes Olympic, Bourges Basket, UMMC Ekaterinburg and Cras Basket Taranto. She also played in the WNBA for Washington Mystics. She was inducted into the French Basketball Hall of Fame in 2019.
